name: reindex
description: MUST run FIRST: index workspace before ALL other malong tools. Over-threshold workspaces require two-step confirm (call → get token → confirm). blocking/force options. malong = LLM-native toolset.

workspace_dir.description: Project root (abs). Omit to check indexing status.

confirm.description: Second-step confirmation token from a previous needs_review response (TTL 10 min). REQUIRED to start indexing when total_files > threshold. NEVER invent a token — re-call reindex to get a fresh one.

blocking.description: If true, wait for indexing to complete before returning (default false = async).

force.description: Mark ALL files dirty + re-extract (ignore mtime). Use to purge stale index. Default: incremental.

maxFiles.description: Index upper bound (default 5000): after confirmation, indexing stops at this many files and warns (truncated). Raise it or use ignoreDirs to index everything.

skipDirs.description: Skip specific directories by relative path, e.g. ["runtime1", "0通天/eval-cases"]. Useful when pre-check says too many files.

ignoreDirs.description: Additional directory names to skip globally (e.g. ["deps", "archive"]). Combined with built-in defaults.

threshold.description: Pre-check warning line (default 2000): workspaces with more files return needs_review + confirm_token before indexing (no silent skip).
